en.t: The second Hagia Sophia in Constantinople is consecrated
en.s: Hagia Sophia, officially the Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque, is a mosque and a major cultural and historical site in Istanbul, Turkey. It was formerly a church (360–1453) and a museum (1935–2020). The last of three church buildings to be successively erected on the site by the Eastern Roman Empire, it was completed in AD 537, becoming the world's largest interior space and among the first to employ a fully pendentive dome.

zh.t: 君士坦丁堡第二座圣索菲亚大教堂祝圣
zh.s: 537年12月27日，君士坦丁堡第二座圣索菲亚大教堂举行祝圣仪式。这座教堂在拜占庭帝国时期建成，成为当时世界上内部空间最大的建筑之一。

en.s: The Battle of Wattrelos at the Flemish (now French) town of Wattrelos on 27 December 1566 between a Calvinist rebel army (sometimes described as "Geuzen") and troops of the Spanish Netherlands government. It is sometimes considered as one of the first battles of the Eighty Years' War.

zh.s: 1566年12月27日，加尔文派叛军（有时称为“海上乞丐”）在佛兰德斯的瓦特勒洛与西属尼德兰政府军交战。这场战斗有时被视为八十年战争最早的战役之一。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The naval Battle of Bantam took place on 27 December 1601 in Bantam Bay (now Banten Bay), Indonesia, when an exploration fleet of five Dutch ships under the command of Wolfert Harmensz and a Portuguese fleet under André Furtado de Mendonça, sent from Goa to restore Portuguese authority, met in the Indonesian archipelago. The battle resulted in Dutch victory and forced the Portuguese to retreat.

zh.s: 1601年12月27日，荷兰探险舰队在班丹湾（今万丹湾）与葡萄牙舰队交战。荷兰舰队由沃尔费特·哈门斯率领，葡萄牙舰队则由安德烈·富尔塔多·德·门东萨指挥，最终荷兰获胜，迫使葡萄牙撤退。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The siege of Chichester was a victory by Parliamentarian forces led by Colonel William Waller over a small Royalist garrison. The siege was one of the key events in the First English Civil War by Waller to secure southern England and declare it for Parliament. The siege lasted five days and ended with surrender by the Royalists. Despite the Royalist surrender, Waller's troops proceeded to sack and desecrate Chichester Cathedral.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1642年12月27日，议会军指挥官威廉·沃勒率部迫使保王党驻军投降，结束了持续5天的围城。尽管对方已经投降，沃勒的部下仍洗劫并亵渎了奇切斯特大教堂。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Jasna Góra (also known less accurately as the battle of Częstochowa, Polish: Oblężenie Jasnej Góry) took place in the winter of 1655 during the Second Northern War, or 'The Deluge' – as the Swedish invasion of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth is known. The Swedes were attempting to capture the Jasna Góra monastery in Częstochowa.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 亚斯纳古拉修道院围城战
zh.s: 1655年12月27日，瑞典军队决定撤离亚斯纳古拉修道院，结束围城。此前数周，瑞典军队一直试图攻占这座位于琴斯托霍瓦的修道院。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Methuen Treaty was a military and commercial treaty between England and Portugal signed in 1703 as part of the War of the Spanish Succession. Named after John Methuen, it actually refers to two treaties signed that year.
en.n: Portugal and England sign the Methuen Treaty which allows Portugal to export wines to England on favorable trade terms.

zh.s: 1703年，英格兰与葡萄牙签署《梅休因条约》，给予葡萄牙向英格兰出口葡萄酒的优惠贸易条件。这是两国当年签订的两项条约之一。
zh.n: 1703年12月27日，葡萄牙与英格兰签署《梅休因条约》，允许葡萄牙按优惠贸易条件向英格兰出口葡萄酒。

en.s: The Battle of Cedar Bridge, fought in Barnegat Township, New Jersey, was one of the last skirmishes of the American Revolutionary War, between Continental militia under Captains Richard Shreve and Edward Thomas and Loyalist militia under John Bacon on December 27, 1782. Bacon had killed 30 sleeping American seamen on the colonists' ship, the Alligator, and perpetrated other acts of terror on suspected Continental supporters.

zh.s: 1782年12月27日，美国独立战争期间，理查德·史里夫和爱德华·托马斯率领的大陆军民兵在新泽西州巴尼加特镇与约翰·培根率领的效忠派民兵交战。培根此前杀害了“短吻鳄号”船上30名熟睡的美国水手，并对支持大陆军的人实施过其他恐怖行动。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 1826 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on December 27, 1826, in order to elect the governor of North Carolina. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Hutchins Gordon Burton was re-elected by the North Carolina General Assembly as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1826年12月27日举行北卡罗来纳州州长选举。时任州长、民主共和党人哈钦斯·戈登·伯顿没有对手，由州议会再次选任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Lewes avalanche occurred on 27 December 1836 in Lewes, Sussex, when a huge build-up of snow on a chalk cliff overlooking the town collapsed into the settlement 100 metres below, destroying a row of cottages and killing eight people. It remains the deadliest avalanche on record in the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 1836年12月27日，英国萨塞克斯郡刘易斯镇上方白垩悬崖积雪崩塌，冲入下方约100米处的居民区，摧毁一排小屋，造成8人死亡。这是英国有记录以来死亡人数最多的雪崩。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Rio Grande City was a military engagement during the Cortina War between pro-Mexican Cortinistas and a group of US Army regulars supported by Texas Rangers.

zh.s: 1859年12月27日，在科尔蒂纳战争期间，墨西哥支持者科尔蒂纳派与美国正规军交战，后者得到德克萨斯骑警支援。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Franklin–Nashville campaign, also known as Hood's Tennessee campaign, was a series of battles in the Western Theater, conducted from September 18 to December 27, 1864, in Alabama, Tennessee, and northwestern Georgia during the American Civil War. The Confederate Army of Tennessee under Lieutenant General John B. Hood drove north from Atlanta, threatening Major General William T. Sherman's lines of communications and Middle Tennessee.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 富兰克林—纳什维尔战役
zh.s: 富兰克林—纳什维尔战役又称胡德田纳西战役，是美国内战西部战区的一系列战斗，发生于1864年9月18日至12月27日，地点涉及阿拉巴马州、田纳西州和佐治亚州西北部。田纳西邦联军由约翰·B. 胡德中将指挥，从亚特兰大向北推进，威胁威廉·T. 谢尔曼少将的交通线及田纳西州中部。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Corumbá invasion, in the context of the Paraguayan War, was the first Paraguayan movement within the Brazilian territory, starting the Mato Grosso campaign. On 23 December 1864, Solano López sent about 5,000 men across the Paraguay River under the command of colonel Vicente Barrios. This column attacked the Novo de Coimbra fort on the 27th, which capitulated three days later; the Paraguayans then advanced towards Albuquerque, reaching Corumbá on 4 January 1865.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1864年12月27日，巴拉圭军队进攻新科英布拉要塞。守军3天后投降，巴拉圭军随后向阿尔布开克推进，并于1865年1月4日抵达科伦巴。这场战役开启了巴拉圭战争中的马托格罗索战役。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的行动开始日期。

en.s: The 1870 Manitoba general election held on December 27, 1870, resulted in a victory for Lieutenant Governor Adams George Archibald's governing coalition. Archibald had previously been appointed as the province's Lieutenant Governor by George-Étienne Cartier, and promoted a model of "consensus government," which included members of the province's different ethnic, religious, and linguistic groups.

zh.s: 曼尼托巴省于1870年12月27日举行大选，时任副总督亚当斯·乔治·阿奇博尔德领导的执政联盟获胜。阿奇博尔德倡导组建“共识政府”，吸纳不同族裔、宗教和语言群体的成员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Battle of El Manzano, also known as the Battle of Pachacamac was a confrontation between Peruvian and Chilean forces that occurred on December 27, 1880 in the El Manzano hills on the south side of the Lurín River during the Lima campaign during the War of the Pacific.

zh.s: 硝石战争（太平洋战争）期间，秘鲁和智利军队于1880年12月27日在利马战役中的埃尔曼萨诺山丘交战。该战役也称帕查卡马克战役，战场位于卢林河以南。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The siege of Rustenburg was a siege that took place between 1880 and 1881 during the First Boer War. Boer forces of the South African Republic carried out the siege on Rustenburg, a British-controlled city inside of the Transvaal Colony, and captured it after three months.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1880年12月27日，布尔民兵要求英军驻守的鲁斯滕堡投降，遭守军指挥官拒绝，围城战由此开始。南非共和国军队围困这座德兰士瓦殖民地的城市近三个月后，于1881年将其攻占。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: “Jana Gana Mana” is first sung at the Indian National Congress
en.s: Rabindranath Tagore’s song “Jana Gana Mana” was first publicly sung on December 27, 1911, during the Indian National Congress session in Calcutta, now Kolkata. The song later became India’s national anthem, but that official adoption came on January 24, 1950.
en.n: First public singing at the Calcutta Congress session; national-anthem adoption came in 1950.

zh.t: 《人民的意志》在印度国大党会议上首次公开演唱
zh.s: 1911年12月27日，泰戈尔创作的《人民的意志》（Jana Gana Mana）在印度国大党加尔各答会议上首次公开演唱。这首歌后来成为印度国歌，但正式获选要等到1950年1月24日。
zh.n: 当天是歌曲首次公开演唱；获定为印度国歌是在1950年。

en.s: The Battle of the Strypa (German: Kampf auf der Strype) or Operation on the Strypa (Russian: Операция на Стрыпе) was a Russian offensive from December 27 [O.S. December 14] 1915 to January 26 [O.S. January 13] 1916, in Galicia, near the Strypa River. It ended with the victory of the Central Powers.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 俄军于1915年12月27日至1916年1月26日在加利西亚斯特里帕河附近发动攻势。战役以同盟国胜利告终。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Greater Poland uprising of 1918–1919, or Wielkopolska uprising of 1918–1919 (Polish: powstanie wielkopolskie 1918–1919 roku; German: Großpolnischer Aufstand) or Poznań War was a military insurrection of Poles in the Greater Poland region (German: Grand Duchy of Posen or Provinz Posen) against German rule. The uprising had a significant effect on the Treaty of Versailles, which granted a reconstituted Second Polish Republic the area won by the Polish insurrectionists.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1918年12月27日晚，波兰人在波兹南发动持续至1919年的起义，警察总部前发生枪战，战斗也在周边城镇爆发。起义反抗德国统治，最终促成《凡尔赛条约》将波兰起义军控制的地区划归重建后的波兰共和国。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Dick, Kerr Ladies 4–0 St Helens Ladies
en.s: On 27 December 1920, Dick, Kerr Ladies beat St Helens Ladies 4–0 at Goodison Park in front of 53,000 spectators, an attendance figure for a women's club football match that would not be exceeded for 99 years, and for a women's club football match in the United Kingdom that would not be exceeded for 103 years.

zh.t: 迪克·克尔女子队4比0胜圣海伦斯女子队
zh.s: 1920年12月27日，迪克·克尔女子队在古迪逊公园以4比0击败圣海伦斯女子队，现场有5.3万名观众。这一女子俱乐部足球赛观众纪录保持了99年；英国境内的纪录则保持了103年。

en.t: Kern and Hammerstein's musical play Show Boat, considered to be the first true American musical play, opens at the Ziegfeld Theatre on Broadway
en.s: Show Boat is a musical with music by Jerome Kern and book and lyrics by Oscar Hammerstein II. It is based on Edna Ferber's best-selling 1926 novel of the same name. The musical follows the lives of the performers, stagehands and dock workers on the Cotton Blossom, a Mississippi River show boat, over 40 years from 1887 to 1927. Its themes include racial prejudice and tragic, enduring love.

zh.t: 被视为美国首部真正音乐剧的《演艺船》在百老汇首演
zh.s: 1927年12月27日，科恩与汉默斯坦合作的音乐剧《演艺船》在百老汇齐格菲尔德剧院首演。该剧根据埃德娜·费伯的同名小说改编，讲述密西西比河演艺船“棉花花号”上演职人员的故事。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.t: Radio City Music Hall, "Showplace of the Nation", opens in New York City
en.s: Radio City Music Hall (also known as Radio City) is an entertainment venue and theater at 1260 Avenue of the Americas, within Rockefeller Center, in the Midtown Manhattan neighborhood of New York City. Nicknamed "The Showplace of the Nation", it is the headquarters for the Rockettes. Radio City Music Hall was designed by Edward Durell Stone and Donald Deskey in the Art Deco style.

zh.t: 纽约无线电城音乐厅开幕
zh.s: 无线电城音乐厅于1932年12月27日在纽约市开幕，坐落于洛克菲勒中心。它以“美国演出殿堂”闻名，是火箭女郎舞团的驻地。

en.s: The 1933 Sanitary Board Election was supposed to be held on 27 December 1933 for the one of the 2 unofficial seats in the Sanitary Board of Hong Kong. Only one nomination was received therefore no actual election was held. Only ratepayers who were included in the Special and Common Jury Lists of the years or ratepayers who are exempted from serving on Juries on account of their professional avocations, unofficial members of the Executive or Legislative Council, or categories of profession were entitled to vote at the election. The election occurred as Carlos Henrique Basto who replaced Dr.

zh.s: 1933年香港卫生局选举原定于12月27日举行，改选卫生局两个非官守议席中的一个。由于只有一人获提名，实际没有举行选举。只有列入当年特别陪审团名单或普通陪审团名单的纳税人、因职业原因获豁免陪审义务的纳税人、行政局或立法局非官守议员，以及特定职业类别人士有投票资格。卡洛斯·恩里克·巴斯托接替离港的罗伯托·亚历山德雷·德·卡斯特罗·巴斯托医生后辞职；德·卡斯特罗·巴斯托医生随后恢复民选议员职务。

en.s: An earthquake struck Turkey's eastern Erzincan Province at 1:57:23 a.m. on 27 December 1939 local time with a moment magnitude (Mw) of 7.8 and maximum Mercalli intensity of XII (Extreme). It is tied with the 2023 Turkey–Syria earthquakes as the most powerful earthquake in Turkey to be recorded by instruments. However, it was less powerful than estimates of the 1668 North Anatolia earthquake.

zh.s: 1939年12月27日凌晨1时57分23秒，土耳其东部埃尔津詹省发生7.8级地震，最高烈度达麦加利烈度 XII（极端）。按仪器记录，这与2023年土耳其—叙利亚地震并列为土耳其最强地震。

en.s: The Battle of Kelja, fought from December 25 to December 27, 1939 in and around the village of Kelja (now Portovoe, Priozersky District, Leningrad Oblast, Russia), was a part of the Winter War between Finland and the Soviet Union.
en.n: Winter War: Finland holds off a Soviet attack in the Battle of Kelja.

zh.s: 1939年12月25日至27日，芬兰与苏联军队在凯尔亚村及周边交战。12月27日，芬兰军队在冬季战争中的凯尔亚战役击退了苏军进攻。
zh.n: 冬季战争：芬兰在凯尔亚战役中击退苏军进攻。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained event introduction and exact dated calendar entry

en.s: The Battle of Taipale was a series of battles fought during the Winter War between Finland and Soviet Union from 6 to 27 December 1939. The battles were part of a Soviet campaign to penetrate the Finnish Mannerheim Line in the Karelian Isthmus region to open a route into southern Finland. Despite their numerical superiority, the Soviet forces were unable to break through the Finnish defences.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1939年12月27日，苏军在苏马一带修筑野战工事，显示出转入防御的态势。泰帕莱战役是苏芬冬季战争中持续至当天的一系列战斗，苏军未能突破芬兰的曼纳海姆防线。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Operation Nordseetour (German: North Sea Tour) was a raid conducted between 30 November and 27 December 1940 by the German heavy cruiser Admiral Hipper. It was part of the Battle of the Atlantic of World War II, with the ship seeking to attack Allied convoys in the North Atlantic. Admiral Hipper left Germany on 30 November 1940 and entered the Atlantic after evading British patrols.

zh.s: 德国重巡洋舰“希佩尔海军上将”号于1940年11月30日至12月27日执行突袭，试图袭击北大西洋的盟军船队。这次行动是大西洋战役的一部分。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: Operation Archery, also known as the Måløy Raid, was a British Combined Operations raid during World War II against German positions on the island of Vågsøy, Norway, on 27 December 1941. British Commandos of No. 3 Commando, two troops of No. 2 Commando, a medical detachment of No. 4 Commando, a demolition party from 101 Troop (canoe) of No.

zh.s: “射箭行动”又称马洛伊突袭，是英国联合行动部队于第二次世界大战期间在挪威沃格岛袭击德军阵地的一次行动，发生于1941年12月27日。参战人员包括英国第3突击队、第2突击队的两个分队、第4突击队医疗分队、第101分队（独木舟）的爆破小组（隶属第6突击队），以及挪威独立连第1连的12名士兵。

en.s: Operation Anklet was the codename given to a British Commando raid during the Second World War. The raid on the Lofoten Islands was carried out in December 1941, by 300 men from No. 12 Commando and the Norwegian Independent Company 1. The landing party was supported by 22 ships from three navies. At the same time, another raid was taking place in Vågsøy. This raid was Operation Archery, on 27 December 1941, and Operation Anklet was seen as a diversionary raid for this bigger raid, intended to draw away the German naval and air forces.

zh.s: 1941年12月27日，英国突击队在挪威罗弗敦群岛实施“脚镣”行动，约300名第12突击队队员和挪威独立连第1连士兵参加，另有22艘来自三国海军的舰艇支援。这次突袭意在分散德军海空力量，为同日对沃格岛的“射箭”行动牵制德军。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: Operation Stonewall was an Allied naval and air operation in the Second World War from 26 to 27 December 1943, to intercept blockade-runners sailing to German-occupied France through the Bay of Biscay. Operations Barrier and Freecar, by the Allied navies and the Brazilian Air Force, had taken place in the south- and mid-Atlantic.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1943年12月27日，盟军飞机在比斯开湾发现德国封锁船“阿尔斯特乌费尔”号并发动空袭。当天下午16时07分，英国皇家空军第311中队一架解放者轰炸机发射火箭弹、投下炸弹，将其击中并引燃；船只次日沉没，74名幸存者在48小时后获加拿大护卫舰救起。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The IMF formally came into existence on 27 December 1945, when the first 29 countries ratified its Articles of Agreement
en.s: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is an international financial institution and a specialized agency of the United Nations, headquartered in Washington, D.C. It consists of 191 member countries, and its stated mission is "working to foster global monetary cooperation, secure financial stability, facilitate international trade, promote high employment and sustainable economic growth, and reduce poverty around the world".

zh.t: 国际货币基金组织正式成立
zh.s: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）是总部设在华盛顿特区的国际金融机构，也是联合国专门机构。它有191个成员国，宗旨是促进全球货币合作、保障金融稳定、推动国际贸易、促进高就业和可持续经济增长，并在世界各地减少贫困。

en.t: Indonesian National Revolution: Queen Juliana of the Netherlands signed papers that relinquished sovereignty of most of the Dutch East Indies, officially recognising the independence of Indonesia
en.s: The Indonesian National Revolution (Indonesian: Revolusi Nasional Indonesia), also known as the Indonesian War of Independence, was an armed conflict and diplomatic struggle between the Republic of Indonesia and the Dutch Empire and an internal social revolution during postwar and postcolonial Indonesia. It took place between Indonesia's declaration of independence in 1945 and the Netherlands' transfer of sovereignty over the Dutch East Indies to the Republic of the United States of Indonesia at the end of 1949.

zh.t: 印度尼西亚民族革命：荷兰女王朱丽安娜签署文件，放弃对荷属东印度群岛大部分地区的主权，正式承认印度尼西亚独立
zh.s: 印度尼西亚民族革命又称印度尼西亚独立战争，是印度尼西亚共和国与荷兰帝国之间的武装冲突和外交斗争，也是战后及后殖民时期的一场内部社会革命。冲突从1945年印度尼西亚宣布独立开始，至1949年底荷兰将荷属东印度群岛主权移交给印度尼西亚联邦共和国为止。

en.s: The 1959 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1958–59 DFB-Pokal, the 16th season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 27 December 1959 at the Auestadion in Kassel. Schwarz-Weiß Essen won the match 5–2 against Borussia Neunkirchen, to claim their 1st cup title.

The Inyenzi were a collection of ethnically Tutsi exiles who were affiliated with the Rwandan political party Union Nationale Rwandaise (UNAR), which had supported Rwanda's deposed Tutsi monarchy.

en.s: On December 27, 1968, North Central Airlines Flight 458 crashed into a hangar while attempting a night landing in poor weather at O'Hare International Airport in Chicago, Illinois, in the United States. Of the 41 passengers and four crew members, only 17 passengers and one crew member survived. One person was killed and six were injured on the ground.

zh.t: 北方中央航空458号班机事故

en.s: Operation Storm-333 (Russian: Шторм-333, Shtorm-333) was a military raid executed by the Soviet Union in Afghanistan on 27 December 1979. Special forces and airborne troops stormed the heavily fortified Tajbeg Palace in Kabul and assassinated Afghan leader Hafizullah Amin, a Khalqist of the People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan (PDPA) who had taken power in the Saur Revolution of April 1978. It was the start of the Soviet–Afghan War.

en.t: Protestant paramilitary leader Billy Wright is assassinated in Northern Ireland, United Kingdom
en.s: William Stephen Wright (7 July 1960 – 27 December 1997), known as King Rat, was a Northern Irish loyalist paramilitary leader who founded the Loyalist Volunteer Force (LVF) during The Troubles. Wright had joined the Ulster Volunteer Force (UVF) in his home town of Portadown around 1975. After spending several years in prison, he became a Protestant fundamentalist preacher.

zh.t: 新教准军事组织领导人比利·赖特遇刺身亡
zh.s: 威廉·斯蒂芬·赖特（1960年7月7日—1997年12月27日），绰号“鼠王”，是北爱尔兰亲英派准军事组织领导人，曾在北爱问题期间创立效忠志愿军（LVF）。赖特约于1975年在家乡波塔当加入阿尔斯特志愿军（UVF）。服刑数年后，他成为新教原教旨主义传教士。

en.s: Starrcade (1998) was the sixteenth annual Starrcade professional wrestling pay-per-view event. It was the eleventh Starrcade event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW), and it took place on December 27, 1998 from the MCI Center in Washington, D.C. The main event was a No Disqualification match between Goldberg and Kevin Nash for the WCW World Heavyweight Championship. Their feud began when Nash won a battle royal at World War 3, and earned a title match. Other matches included Diamond Dallas Page against The Giant, Eric Bischoff against Ric Flair, and Konnan against Chris Jericho for the WCW World Television Championship.

en.s: General elections were held in Zambia on 27 December 2001 to elect a President and National Assembly. The result was a victory for the ruling Movement for Multi-Party Democracy, which won 69 of the 150 National Assembly seats and whose candidate, Levy Mwanawasa, won the presidential vote. The results of the elections were disputed by main opposition parties, including the United Party for National Development, which many observers claimed had won the elections. Both domestic and international election monitors cited serious irregularities with the campaign and election, including vote rigging, flawed voter registration, unequal and biased media coverage, and the MMD's improper use of state resources.

en.s: General elections were held in Kenya on 27 December 2002. They saw the end of the long-standing dominance of the Kenya African National Union, which had governed the country since independence in 1963, including 23 years as the only legal party. Mwai Kibaki of the National Rainbow Coalition was elected president, while the National Rainbow Coalition won a majority in the National Assembly. They were the first truly free general elections held in Kenya since independence in 1964; a number of by-election were held in 1966 before the onset of de facto one-party rule in 1969.

zh.s: 肯尼亚于2002年12月27日举行大选。执政多年的肯尼亚非洲民族联盟败选，彩虹民族联盟的姆瓦伊·齐贝吉当选总统，该联盟也赢得国民议会多数席位。这被认为是肯尼亚自1964年独立以来首次真正自由的大选；1966年曾举行过数次补选，此后肯尼亚于1969年起事实上实行一党执政。

en.s: The Battle of Jowhar was a battle in the 2006 Somali War fought between the Islamic Courts Union (ICU) and affiliated militias against Ethiopian and Transitional Federal Government (TFG) forces for control of the town of Jowhar (located at 2°46′48″N 45°30′08″E / 2.78000°N 45.50222°E). It began on December 27, 2006, when retreating ICU forces regrouped near their stronghold of Jowhar. It became the last major town and strategic stronghold of the ICU to fall to Ethiopian and TFG forces before the latter overtook Mogadishu two days later.

en.s: General elections were held in Kenya on 27 December 2007, electing the President, National Assembly and local councils. The presidential elections were a two-horse race between incumbent Mwai Kibaki, running on a Party of National Unity (PNU) ticket and Raila Odinga, leader of the Orange Democratic Movement (ODM). They were strongly marked by tribal hostility, with Kibaki a member of the traditionally dominant Kikuyu ethnic group, gaining much support amongst the Kikuyu and neighbouring groups in central Kenya, including the Embu and Meru.

en.s: The assassination of Benazir Bhutto occurred on 27 December 2007 in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. Bhutto, twice Prime Minister of Pakistan (1988–1990; 1993–1996) and then-leader of the opposition Pakistan Peoples Party, had been campaigning ahead of elections scheduled for January 2008. Shots were fired at her after a political rally at Liaquat National Bagh, and a suicide bomb was detonated immediately following the shooting. She was declared dead at 18:16 local time (13:16 UTC), at Rawalpindi General Hospital. Twenty-four other people were killed by the bombing. Bhutto had previously survived a similar attempt on her life that killed at least 139 people, after her return from exile two months earlier.

zh.t: 贝娜齐尔·布托遇刺身亡
zh.s: 2007年12月27日，巴基斯坦前总理贝娜齐尔·布托在拉瓦尔品第遇刺。她曾于1988至1990年、1993至1996年两度担任巴基斯坦总理，当时是反对党巴基斯坦人民党领袖，正在为定于2008年1月举行的选举造势。利亚卡特国家公园的一场政治集会后，她遭枪击，随后立即发生自杀式爆炸。她于当地时间18时16分（协调世界时13时16分）在拉瓦尔品第总医院被宣布死亡。爆炸还造成24人遇难。两个月前布托结束流亡返国后，曾遭遇一次类似袭击并幸存；那次袭击至少造成139人死亡。

en.s: The 2007–2008 Kenyan crisis was a violent political, economic, and humanitarian crisis in Kenya. Supporters of Kibaki's main opponent in that election, Raila Odinga of the Orange Democratic Movement, alleged electoral manipulation. en.s: The Gaza War, also known as the First Gaza War, Operation Cast Lead, or the Gaza Massacre, and referred to as the Battle of al-Furqan by Hamas, was a three-week armed conflict between Gaza Strip Palestinian paramilitary groups and the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) that began on 27 December 2008 and ended on 18 January 2009 with a unilateral ceasefire.

zh.s: 加沙战争也称“铸铅行动”或“第一次加沙战争”，是加沙地带巴勒斯坦武装组织与以色列国防军之间为期三周的武装冲突。冲突于2008年12月27日爆发，2009年1月18日以单方面停火结束。

en.s: The first round of the fifth presidential election in Croatia was held on Sunday, December 27, 2009, with twelve candidates participating. The second round between first-round winner Ivo Josipović and first-round runner-up Milan Bandić was held on Sunday, January 10, 2010. Ivo Josipović won a landslide victory receiving 60.3% of the vote becoming the first elected president nominated by the Social Democratic Party of Croatia (SDP).

zh.s: 克罗地亚第五届总统选举首轮投票于2009年12月27日举行，共有12名候选人参选。伊沃·约西波维奇和米兰·班迪奇进入次轮；次轮于2010年1月10日举行，约西波维奇以60.3%的得票率大胜，当选总统。

en.s: The night raid on Narang was a night raid on a household in the village of Ghazi Khan in the early morning hours of December 27, 2009. The operation was authorized by NATO and resulted in the death of ten Afghan civilians, most of whom were students, and some of whom were children.

zh.s: 2009年12月27日凌晨，北约授权的部队夜袭阿富汗库纳尔省加齐汗村一户人家，造成10名阿富汗平民死亡，其中大多数是学生，也有儿童。

en.s: The 2011–12 Strait of Hormuz dispute was a dispute between a coalition of countries and Iran. The dispute arose on 27 December 2011, when Iranian Vice President Mohammad Reza Rahimi warned of closing the Strait of Hormuz. Subsequently, a number of naval drills and missile tests were carried out by Iran.

en.s: The Leyenda de Plata (2014) was professional wrestling tournament produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council") that ran from December 20, 2013, over the course of three of CMLL's Friday night shows in Arena México with the finals on January 3, 2014. The annual Leyenda de Plata tournament is held in honor of lucha libre legend El Santo and is one of CMLL's most important annual tournaments.

zh.s: 2014年“白银传奇”（Leyenda de Plata）是墨西哥世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的职业摔角锦标赛。比赛从2013年12月20日开始，跨越该组织在墨西哥竞技场举办的三场周五晚间赛事，决赛于2014年1月3日举行。年度“白银传奇”锦标赛为纪念墨西哥摔角传奇人物圣人（El Santo）而举办，是CMLL最重要的年度赛事之一。

en.s: On December 27, 2018, jihadists from Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin attacked Burkinabe soldiers in Loroni, northern Burkina Faso, killing ten soldiers. The attack was the deadliest incident for Burkinabe forces since the Nassoumbou attack in 2016.

zh.s: 2018年12月27日，“伊斯兰与穆斯林支持组织”武装人员在布基纳法索北部洛罗尼袭击布基纳法索士兵，造成10名士兵死亡。这是自2016年纳苏姆布袭击以来布军伤亡最惨重的一起事件。

en.s: Bek Air Flight 2100 was a domestic passenger flight from Almaty to Nur-Sultan, Kazakhstan, operated by a Fokker 100 that crashed on 27 December 2019 while taking off from Almaty International Airport. Of the 98 people on board (93 passengers and 5 crew), 13 died in the crash and 66 were injured. The Kazakh government started investigations on the same day.

zh.s: 2019年12月27日，Bek Air 2100号班机从阿拉木图国际机场起飞时坠毁。机上98人（93名乘客、5名机组人员）中有13人遇难、66人受伤。哈萨克斯坦政府当天启动调查。

en.s: General elections were held in the Central African Republic on 27 December 2020 to elect the President and National Assembly. A second round of the legislative elections was originally scheduled to take place on 14 February 2021. Voting was not able to take place in many areas of the country that are controlled by armed groups resulting in some Central African media and opposition candidates describing the elections as a farce and fraud.

zh.s: 中非共和国于2020年12月27日举行总统和国民议会选举。许多受武装组织控制的地区无法投票，一些当地媒体和反对派候选人因此称选举是一场闹剧和舞弊。立法选举第二轮原定于2021年2月14日举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Niger on 27 December 2020 to elect the President and National Assembly. With incumbent president Mahamadou Issoufou stepping down after reaching his constitutional two-term limit, new presidential candidates contested the office. As no candidate received a majority in the first round, a second round was held on 21 February 2021.

zh.s: 尼日尔于2020年12月27日举行总统和国民议会选举。时任总统马哈马杜·伊素福因已达宪法规定的两届任期上限而卸任。首轮投票无人得票过半，第二轮于2021年2月21日举行。

en.s: The 2022 Rangpur City Corporation election was a local government election in the city of Rangpur, Bangladesh, held on 27 December 2022 to elect the Mayor of Rangpur and the Rangpur City Council. The election resulted in a victory for the Jatiya Party (Ershad) candidate Mostafizar Rahman Mostafa.

en.s: The 2025 United Cup was the third edition of the United Cup, an international outdoor hard court mixed-gender team tennis tournament held by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) and the Women's Tennis Association (WTA). Serving as the opener for the 2025 ATP Tour and the 2025 WTA Tour, it was held from 27 December 2024 to 5 January 2025 at two venues in the Australian cities of Perth and Sydney.

zh.s: 第三届联合杯网球赛于2024年12月27日至2025年1月5日在澳大利亚珀斯和悉尼举行，是2025年ATP巡回赛和WTA巡回赛的揭幕赛事。比赛为室外硬地男女混合团体赛，由ATP和WTA共同举办。

en.s: The 2024 Victorian Liberal Party leadership spill was held on 27 December 2024 to elect the leader of the Victorian Liberal Party and, ex officio, Leader of the Opposition. Incumbent leader John Pesutto lost a spill motion and was replaced by Brad Battin in the subsequent leadership election.

zh.s: 2024年12月27日，澳大利亚维多利亚州自由党举行党魁改选。现任党魁约翰·佩苏托在不信任动议中落败，随后由布拉德·巴廷接任。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Ivory Coast on 27 December 2025. The ruling Rally of Houphouëtists for Democracy and Peace won 197 of 255 seats in the National Assembly.

zh.s: 科特迪瓦于2025年12月27日举行国民议会选举。执政的乌弗埃主义者民主与和平联盟赢得255个议席中的197席。
